baseline.value: Age-disaggregated HIV data for adolescents unavailable (DHIS2, CTC)

target.value: 2022:HIV data for adolescents (10-14, 15-19, 20-24 years) available (DHIS2, CTC)

title.narrative: Rescurces mobilized for children and AIDS through large funding mechanisims such as the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and malaria and PEPFAR(65008), Text

baseline.value: GFATM grant approved, including 16 mill USD for AGYW (2018); PEPFAR DREAMS approved for USD 100 mill (2018)

target.value: 2022:UNICEF in PEPFAR and GFATM planning and programme review processes; UNICEF on national AGYW steering committee; Reports on implementation progress and funding levels through national coordination mech

actual.value: 2021:UNICEF in PEPFAR and GFATM planning and programme review processes; UNICEF in national AGYW steering committee; Reports on implementation progress and funding levels through national coordination mechanisms

title.narrative: National HIV Strategic plan/guidance for care and treatment that are aligned to Global targets and the most recent WHO recommendations for care and treatment of children , adolescents and pregnant/breast feeding women, Text

baseline.value: WHO ART guidelines introduced in 2017; HSHSP IV launched 2017; National Service Delivery Model developed 2017

target.value: 2022:National HIV Treatment guidelines, including service delivery model for children and adolescents implemented; Mid term review of HSHSP IV; Updated ART guidelines; Age of consent for HIV lowered

actual.value: 2021:National HIV Treatment guidelines, including service delivery model for children and adolescents implementation ongoing, new HSHSP is under development so mid-term review is not planned anymore, ART guidelines already updated, age of consent for HIV lower
